:::{#exm-logistic-function}
#### Values of the logistic function

The [logistic function](#def-logistic-function) at $\logodds = -2$, $\logodds = 0$ or $\logodds = 2$ has these [values](#def-value):

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
eta <- c(-2, 0, 2)
data.frame(eta = eta, sigmoid = 1 / (1 + exp(-eta)))
```

The [value](#def-value) at $\logodds = 0$ is $1 / (1 + \e{-0}) = 1/2$.
The values at $\pm 2$ add to 1; each lies in $(0, 1)$.
:::
